Other Ways to Give

Donate by Check

Make checks payable to charity: water. If you're donating in honor of someone, sponsoring a water project or want to direct your donation to our operating costs, please write that in the memo of your check.

Unfortunately, we cannot accept donations to The Spring via check.

Tax receipts will be mailed within four to six weeks after the donation has been processed.

International Giving

charity: water is a registered charity in the UK. To make a tax-efficient donation in GBP, visit charitywateruk.org. For other international donations, we accept bank issued money orders in USD. Money orders should be made payable to charity: water and can be mailed to the address below. For donations over $6,000, we also accept wire transfers; email info@charitywater.org for more information.

Please note, only donations made by eligible US taxpayers may be tax-deductible.

Donate Stock

We're able to accept donations in the form of stock, government (including municipal) debt and corporate debt through the Depository Trust Company (DTC). For security, settlement and reduced paperwork, electronic transfer through the DTC is preferred. This can be arranged from most brokerage accounts.

Unfortunately, we cannot accept donations to The Spring via stock.

Please contact info@charitywater.org for more information on making a stock donation.

Meet the Executive Team

charity: water’s executive team brings together decades of experience in global development, nonprofit leadership, and strategic partnerships — all united by a shared commitment to ending the global water crisis. With integrity, vision, and a deep sense of responsibility, they guide our mission to bring clean and safe water to every person on the planet.

Founder & Chief executive officer

Scott Harrison

Scott spent almost 10 years as a nightclub promoter in New York City before leaving to volunteer on a hospital ship off the coast of Liberia, West Africa as a photojournalist. Returning home to New York City two years later, he founded the nonprofit organization charity: water in 2006. In 18 years, with the help of more than 1 million donors worldwide, charity: water has raised $1 billion and funded over 186,000 water projects in 29 countries.

HEAR SCOTT'S STORY
President

Melissa Russell

Melissa Russell is the President of charity: water and a globally respected nonprofit executive with over 20 years of experience leading and scaling mission-driven organizations. She has helped drive more than $1.5 billion in philanthropic capital and led global teams around the world. Melissa is known for aligning bold vision with measurable outcomes, cultivating trusted partnerships, and building high-performing teams committed to solving the global water crisis in our lifetime.

Chief Revenue Officer

Ben Greene

Ben Greene is the Chief Revenue Officer at charity: water, driving the brand, marketing, and fundraising teams. With over 20 years in the nonprofit sector, including leadership roles at World Vision, Feed the Children, and Food for the Hungry, he is known for driving sustainable impact and leading multi-million dollar campaigns. Ben lives in Nashville, Tennessee, with his wife, Melissa, and their two children, Hutch and Haven.

Chief Water Programs Officer

Brian Hoyer

Brian Hoyer is the Chief Programs Officer at charity: water, leading its programmatic work across 58 local partners in 22 countries. His experience in global health, emergency response and recovery, and rural WASH over the past 20 years informs his current work at charity: water. He has specialized in convening strong and locally led teams to work on a range of public health issues, from large-scale cholera response to ebola treatment and prevention.

Chief Technology Officer

Christa Stelzmuller

Christa Stelzmuller is the Chief Technology Officer at charity: water where she is focused on building innovative and impactful digital experiences, driven by the organization’s mission. Throughout her career, she has consistently taken a multidisciplinary approach to leveraging data and technology, which has enabled better decisions, stronger products, and more effective delivery. Christa is known for her ability to translate vision into strategy and turn that strategy into action. Her strengths in communication and team leadership are key to her success, fostering a culture of productivity and collaboration through a service-oriented, participative leadership style.

Chief Financial Officer

John Passauer

John Passauer is the Chief Financial Officer at charity: water, bringing decades of financial leadership across the nonprofit, alternative energy, software, and telecommunications sectors. His career has taken him around the world, with leadership roles and board service spanning Brazil, the UK, South Africa, Chile, Kenya, Malaysia, India, and China, giving him a uniquely global perspective on building finance teams and systems that support growing organizations. Known for navigating complex financial challenges, John is equally passionate about the people side of the work, developing strong teams and implementing the infrastructure that allows mission-driven organizations to thrive.

General Counsel

Ceena Johnson

Ceena Johnson is the General Counsel at charity: water, providing practical, solution-oriented legal counsel that enables partnerships, protects trust, and helps teams move with clarity and confidence. With a career shaped by a commitment to law in service of global impact, she brings experience advising on the legal and operational work that allows mission-driven organizations to scale. At charity: water, she leads across data privacy, enterprise risk, and governance, integrating legal judgment into decision-making in a way that strengthens both momentum and trust.

Stay connected to the team

Our leadership team is actively engaged in shaping the global conversation around clean water access, sustainability, and nonprofit innovation. Explore the latest insights and media featuring our team — and see how their voices are helping to drive change on a global scale.

Financials

We know it's important to you that your donation is being used effectively. It's important to us, too. That's why we work hard to receive the highest grades available for accountability and transparency.

The Fiscal Year 2025 Annual Report is here.

The charity: water team has always operated with two core beliefs: every dollar you give should do as much good as possible, and you deserve to see exactly how it’s used.

In fiscal year 2025, those beliefs drove everything we accomplished together. Public donations funded more than 22,000 water projects across 20 countries, bringing clean and safe water to 1.41 million people for the very first time.

Our Fiscal Year 2025 Annual Report highlights the successes and innovations of our work, provides an overview of our financial position, and offers a high-level look at our impact in every nation where we work.

We received a clean opinion from auditors at KPMG, and if you’d like to read their detailed audit report, you may also view it below.

Careers

Quit your day job and come change the world

See open positions

A mission like ours needs a perspective like yours

At charity: water, we value every background, identity, and experience. We believe that a diverse team, informed by different cultures and perspectives, makes us stronger.

We are committed to doing the work and challenging each other to be an organization in which everyone is respected and heard. We commit to providing genuine opportunities for all people to thrive. And we will continue to embed diversity, inclusion, belonging, and equality in everything we do.

Benefits and Perks

Changing the world is a whole lot of work, so we take good care of our team.

First-of-its-kind bonus program

Thanks to our giving community, The Pool, full-time employees have the opportunity to receive cash bonuses from the proceeds of IPOs and other liquidity events.
